newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VIISNURK SHARE ISSUE ON COURSE FOR MAY 11.
newsitem.headline: VIISNURK SHARE ISSUE ON COURSE FOR MAY 11.

text.p: An 11.7 million kroon share issue by ski-maker Viisnurk is on course and will be distributed from May 12-26, Hansa Investments said on Wednesday.
"The nominal price of the 90,000 new shares will be 10 kroons and the sale price will be 130 kroons," Hansa's Kristel Tumm told Reuters.
Current shareholders have priority purchase rights.
The company is also seeking a listing on the secondary market of the Tallinn bourse.
"It is certainly a good stock and the company has good strategic investors. But low liquidity on the market and the priority purchase rights may dampen demand for the issue," one analyst said.
Viisnurk, one of the world's largest ski makers, had a 1996 net turnover of 154 million kroons and its profit was 8.1 million kroons.
The company's forecast for 1997 is for a net turnover of 185 million kroons and a profit of 10 million kroons.
The majority holding in the company is held by VN Holding company whose largest investor is the London-based Baltic Republics Fund.
